label: No sound
description: Complete absence of audio output from the equipment

label: Low volume
description: Audio output is present but significantly quieter than expected

label: Distorted sound
description: Audio sounds harsh, clipped, or distorted — not a clean signal

label: Hum or buzz
description: Persistent low-frequency hum (50/60 Hz) or high-frequency buzz in the audio

label: Acoustic feedback
description: A loud squeal or howl caused by the microphone picking up its own amplified signal

label: One channel not working
description: Audio is absent or significantly reduced on one side (left or right) only

label: Crackling or intermittent sound
description: Audio cuts in and out, pops, or crackles — especially when cables are moved
